projects.title: Solar Proa II - Power Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Designed and implemented a high powered electrical system and wireless communication network for sensor communication and data collection for a wind and solar powered 48V, 4kW electrical vessel using custom firmware, software, hardware and PCB. 
 - Consist of a network of **ESP32** and **Raspberry Pi** devices that communicate with each other using **ESP-NOW** protocol to run a custom **(E) Kalman Filter** algorithm. 
 - Developed a **web-based dashboard** using **React** and **Node.js** to visualize the power consumption data and provide real-time feedback to the user, including a developer / admin portal with authentication for controlling the system.

projects.title: Solar Proa II - Digital Twin & Simulation
projects.bodyText:
- A digital twin and simulation of the Solar Proa II vessel using **GNU Make**, **Python**, and **PySpice**. 
 - The software uses a parametised step model approach to achieve a single, unified model for the vessel. 
 - The simulation is used to test and validate the power management system, electrical wiring, and the vessel's performance under different conditions such as varying weather and time of day.

projects.title: PDF and Image Converter
projects.bodyText:
- A Windows application with UI that runs locally to modify PDF and Image page ordering. Mainly used for re-ordering pdf pages and inserting images between them. Can convert images to PDF and vice versa with option for different formats and quality.
 - Allows for compact view & disabling preview to load pdf with hundreds of pages in seconds. 
 - Made using **Python**, **PySide** and **PyInstaller**.
 - Not meant for photo editing.

projects.title: Trie Auto Complete
projects.bodyText: - A command-line interface application for auto-completing words using a Trie data structure.

projects.title: Text to (QR) Code Generator
projects.bodyText:
- A JavaFX App that generates **QR Code** from text and vice versa.
 - Uses **ZXing** library to generate QR Code.
 - Can save the generated QR Code as an image.
 - Supports different encryption levels, color and customised logo in the QR Code.
 - Comes with a **QR Code Scanner** that uses **OpenCV** for image correction and scan QR Codes from images and camera used for additional validation of generated codes.
 - As this is the first Java app I made, it is badly designed, slow and cannot be exported as an appication but works fine otherwise.

projects.title: Bank Sync
projects.bodyText:
- A simple Transation Statement parser and organiser web app made with **React** and **Supabase**.
 - Real transaction data from common banks in Singapore is parsed and stored in a database.
 - Users can view, update and export their transactions and filter by date, category, and amount, giving user full control over their financial data.
